			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_2 days = 365 }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_answered }
					COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_peace = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_defeat }
					hidden_trigger = {
						check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 }
				}
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_2_active days = 365 }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_2 }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_answered
				COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 40 }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_ARG.15.option_3
		trigger = {
			COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_peace = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_defeat
			hidden_trigger = {
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
		}
		effect_tooltip = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 }
			}
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_ARG_war_defeat
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_answered }
					COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_peace = yes
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_south_atlantic_defeat
					hidden_trigger = {
						check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = {
					treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 }
				}
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_3_active
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_ARG_war_defeat
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_event_war_outcome_answered
				COLDWAR_ARG_refresh_programmes = yes
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 40 }
	}
